assignments.name: Store_AccountId
assignments.description: Extracts the AccountId from the retrieved Opportunity record and stores it into the accountIdVar text variable for use in subsequent Case query filtering
assignments.label: Store AccountId

assignments.name: Add_Case_Id_To_Collection
assignments.description: Adds the current loop item's Id field to the caseIds text collection variable to build up the collection of Case IDs needed for the CaseMilestone IN filter
assignments.label: Add Case Id To Collection

assignments.name: Count_Total_Cases
assignments.description: Counts the total number of Case records retrieved by Get_Cases and stores the count in the TotalCases number variable using the AssignCount operator
assignments.label: Count Total Cases

assignments.name: Count_Violated_Milestones
assignments.description: Counts the total number of violated CaseMilestone records retrieved by Get_Violated_CaseMilestones and stores the count in the ViolatedCount number variable using the AssignCount operator
assignments.label: Count Violated Milestones

formulas.name: SLA_Summary_Text
formulas.description: Formats the total Cases count and violated CaseMilestones count into a summary text string in the format 'Total Cases: N, Violated: M' for display in the Opportunity SLA_Summary__c field

loops.name: Loop_Cases
loops.description: Iterates through each Case record in the collection retrieved by Get_Cases to extract individual Case IDs and add them to the caseIds text collection variable for use in the CaseMilestone query filter
loops.label: Loop Cases

recordLookups.name: Get_Opportunity
recordLookups.description: Retrieves the Opportunity record by Id to access its AccountId field for subsequent Case query filtering
recordLookups.label: Get Opportunity

recordLookups.name: Get_Cases
recordLookups.description: Queries all Case records where AccountId equals the accountIdVar text variable to retrieve the collection of Cases related to the Opportunity's Account for processing and counting
recordLookups.label: Get Cases

recordLookups.name: Get_Violated_CaseMilestones
recordLookups.description: Queries CaseMilestone records filtered by CaseId IN caseIds collection AND IsViolated equals true to retrieve only violated milestones using the direct CaseId field with IN operator
recordLookups.label: Get Violated CaseMilestones

recordUpdates.name: Update_Opportunity_SLA_Summary
recordUpdates.description: Updates the Opportunity record's SLA_Summary__c field with the formatted summary text combining total Cases count and violated CaseMilestones count
recordUpdates.label: Update Opportunity SLA Summary

variables.name: recordId
variables.description: Input variable that holds the Opportunity Id passed into the autolaunched flow for processing SLA summary

variables.name: accountIdVar
variables.description: Text variable that stores the AccountId from the retrieved Opportunity record for use in subsequent Case query filtering

variables.name: caseIds
variables.description: Text collection variable that stores Case IDs extracted from the loop to be used in the CaseMilestone query filter with the IN operator

variables.name: TotalCases
variables.description: Number variable that stores the total count of Case records retrieved by Get_Cases for use in the SLA summary text

variables.name: ViolatedCount
variables.description: Number variable that stores the count of violated CaseMilestone records retrieved by Get_Violated_CaseMilestones for use in the SLA summary text
